name: so-transfer-pricing
description: Somalia related-party pricing working paper for 2026 preparation using the enacted Income Tax Act 37 of 2025, articles 4 and 37. It screens association, resident and non-resident status and transaction facts, then compares recorded amounts with a supported independent-party amount. It covers the 50 percent association boundary, indirect and aggregated rights, the statutory arm's-length standard and adjustment powers. The job produces a pricing reconciliation and unresolved-issues record, not a return or a claim that documentation thresholds or methods have been verified. Income Tax Regulation 0142-2025 ties the standard to the OECD guidelines. Postponement notices and circulars are unchecked, so final 2026 application is gated. Two executable examples test adjustment direction and the association boundary. Independent source review accepted the statutory baseline only; no accountant has attested.
